catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled · independent clinical/pharmacy review pending

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
audit_limitations: Independent oncology and pharmacy approval pending.
Printed count and organ-function gaps yield review, never an inferred normal result.
Source reduction instructions require actual dose history and clinical recovery; unresolved cases do not output an automatic restart dose.
Physical p4 count table is restricted to cycles 2–4 Day 1; no explicit Day 8/15 count table. Ambiguous platelet wording requires source/local clarification.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the NCCP source document. It does not replace the current NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review, or pharmacy verification.

cautions: Review fitness, organ function, cardiac history, prior anthracyclines, fertility and pregnancy risk.
exclusions: Significant cardiac disease or LVEF below source requirement

administration.notes: Review lifetime cumulative anthracycline exposure; source maximum 450 mg/m².

notes: Measured GFR is preferred whenever feasible.
Where overweight or obesity may overestimate GFR, adjusted ideal body weight in Cockcroft-Gault may be considered.
If isotope GFR is used, dose may remain unchanged while serum creatinine is <=110% of the value at isotope measurement.
If serum creatinine rises, consider remeasurement or re-estimation of GFR.

baseline: ECG may be added under separately attributed cardio-oncology guidance
regular: FBC, renal and liver weekly during platinum/taxane; before every AC dose and weekly throughout chemotherapy
Echo/MUGA and audiology when clinically indicated

rule_engine.conflict_policy: Return the most restrictive applicable action and display every triggered rule.
rule_engine.missing_data_policy: Evaluate supplied values independently. Missing values remain unassessed; never infer normality or phase.
